name: arr-large-passthrough-items
description: Top-level JSON array of 2500 small objects {id, tag}. Body is 53891 bytes; each item is ~21 bytes (well under threshold) so individual items are passthrough-kept; the root array is sentinel-elided to head/tail. Sized so the elided (hidden) portion clears the min-hidden-bytes floor (32 KB default) — a smaller array here would passthrough entirely and stop exercising the array-elision + tool_output_fetch round trip this fixture is for. Exercises the top-level-array elision branch.
as_used_by: any tool returning a large top-level JSON array of many small items
